contentHtml:
pecan pie bars bring back warm-kitchen nostalgia with bubbling, nutty sweetness in every bite. A buttery shortbread base cradles a gooey pecan layer laced with golden maple syrup and a touch of citrus for balanced brightness. Toasted pecans stud the top for irresistible crunch against the caramel-like filling. Whether you want a cozy afternoon treat or a shareable dessert for friends, pecan pie bars deliver homestyle charm with a modern lift. Slice, serve, and watch the smiles grow with each rich, buttery square.

Why You’ll Love This Pecan Pie Bars

  • Irresistibly sweet and nutty flavor in every bite.
  • Easy to make, perfect for baking novices and pros alike.
  • Great for sharing at gatherings or enjoying solo.
  • Deliciously chewy texture with a buttery crust.
  • Versatile dessert that pairs well with coffee or tea.

Pecan Pie Bars

Indulge in the ultimate Pecan Pie Bars! These stunning treats combine rich flavors and a buttery crust for a delightful dessert experience. 🥧✨
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 15 minutes mins
Cook Time 43 minutes mins
Total Time 58 minutes mins
Servings: 16 servings
Course: Dessert
Cuisine: American
Calories: 250
Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Crust
  • 1 ½ cups all-purpose flour for the base
  • ¼ cup granulated sugar adds sweetness
  • ½ teaspoon salt enhances flavor
  • ½ cup unsalted butter cold and cubed for the crust
Filling
  • 3 large eggs at room temperature for best texture
  • 1 cup light brown sugar packed, for sweetness and depth
  • ½ cup light corn syrup acts as a binder
  • 2 tablespoons unsalted butter melted, for the filling
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract adds a warm flavor
  • ¼ teaspoon salt balances sweetness
  • 1 ½ cups chopped pecans the star ingredient!

Equipment

  • 1 8×8-inch baking pan For baking the bars
  • 1 Medium Bowl For mixing the crust and filling
  • 1 whisk For mixing ingredients
  • 1 wire rack For cooling the bars

Method
 

Preheat the Oven
  1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Line an 8×8-inch baking pan with parchment paper, leaving an overhang for easy removal.
Make the Crust
  1. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt. Cut in cold butter cubes until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Press evenly into the bottom of the prepared pan.
Bake the Crust
  1. Bake the crust for 15–18 minutes, or until lightly golden. Remove from the oven and set aside.
Prepare the Filling
  1. Meanwhile, whisk together eggs, brown sugar, corn syrup, melted butter, vanilla, and salt until smooth. Stir in chopped pecans.
Pour the Filling
  1. Pour the filling over the warm crust and spread it evenly.
Bake Again
  1. Return to the oven and bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the filling is set around the edges but still slightly jiggly in the center.
Cool the Bars
  1. Allow the bars to cool completely in the pan on a wire rack.
Cut the Bars
  1. Using the parchment overhang, lift the bars out of the pan and cut into squares.
Serve and Store
  1. Serve at room temperature or chilled. Store in an airtight container for up to 4 days.

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making Pecan Pie Bars

  • Toast the pecans for deeper flavor.
  • Chill the bars before cutting for clean edges.
  • Use a mix of brown and granulated sugar for balanced sweetness.
  • Substitute corn syrup with maple syrup for a unique twist.
  • Let the bars cool completely to set the filling perfectly.

How to Serve this Pecan Pie Bars

  • Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top.
  • Drizzle with caramel sauce for an extra sweet touch.
  • Pair with a dollop of whipped cream for a light finish.
  • Enjoy with a cup of coffee or a warm chai latte.
  • Top with chocolate chips for a delightful twist.
  • Sprinkle sea salt on top to enhance the flavors.

Make Ahead and Storage

Here’s how to keep your Pecan Pie Bars fresh and delicious:

Storing Pecan Pie Bars Leftovers

  • Allow bars to cool completely before storing.
  • Place in an airtight container.
  • Store at room temperature for up to 3 days.
  • For longer storage, refrigerate for up to a week.

Freezing Pecan Pie Bars

  • Wrap bars tightly in plastic wrap.
  • Place wrapped bars in a freezer-safe container.
  • Freeze for up to 3 months for best quality.
  • Label with the date for easy tracking.

Reheating Pecan Pie Bars

  • Thaw bars in the refrigerator overnight if frozen.
  • Reheat in a preheated oven at 350°F (175°C) for 10-15 minutes.
  • Microwave for 15-20 seconds for a quick warm-up.
  • Serve warm for the best texture and flavor.

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. Do pecan pie bars need to be refrigerated?

Pecan pie bars can be stored at room temperature for a couple of days, but it’s best to refrigerate them if you want to keep them fresh for longer. Refrigeration helps maintain their texture and flavor, especially if you live in a warm climate. Just make sure to cover them well to prevent them from drying out!

2. Is light or dark Karo syrup better for pecan pie?

Both light and dark Karo syrup can be used in pecan pie bars, but they will yield slightly different flavors. Light Karo syrup is milder and sweeter, while dark Karo syrup has a richer, more robust flavor due to the molasses content. If you prefer a deeper flavor, go for dark syrup!

3. Which US state is famous for its pecan pie?

Texas is often considered the home of pecan pie, with the pecan tree being the state tree. The pie has become a beloved dessert in many Southern states, but Texas takes the crown for its rich history and variations of this delicious treat!

4. What are common pecan pie mistakes?

Some common mistakes when making pecan pie include overbaking, which can lead to a dry filling, and not using enough pecans, which can affect the texture and flavor. Additionally, forgetting to let the pie cool completely before slicing can result in a messy presentation. Always follow the recipe closely for the best results!

Final Thoughts

These Pecan Pie Bars are not just a treat; they’re a delightful journey back to cozy family gatherings! With their buttery crust and sweet, nutty filling, they’re simple to make and oh-so-rewarding. So grab your ingredients, channel your inner baker, and enjoy every delicious bite. Trust me, you’ll be glad you did!
